page.introTitle: This table holds two kinds of row
page.introBody: The “Default track” tier is the commission track every individual host enters through — it is not sold, cannot be retired, and there is only ever one. The other tiers are shop plans sold per vehicle slot. “Retired” only blocks new purchases; running subscriptions keep the price and slot count they locked in until their term ends.
